guard: new defaults can create channels, byte-exact legacy defaults upgrade, user-edited personas remain untouched, minted credential lifetimes honor their flags, and an identity re-mint preserves its principal
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:persona-templates && pnpm smoke:mint-provision:auth
why: Setup, space create and a local up write the default persona from a literal template rather than through the guarded agent-file writer.
The cells check the new-install grant and both sides of the byte-exact migration decision without touching real setup state.
The auth-mint smoke also covers mint lifecycle preservation, provisioning, and rejected lifetime inputs.

mutations.name: M1 remove the default wildcard post grant
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:persona-templates
mutations.expectRed: default-channel-creation: default stays unsubscribed with wildcard read and post ACLs
mutations.cell: default-channel-creation: default stays unsubscribed with wildcard read and post ACLs
mutations.note: The static template assertion observes that a fresh default can no longer create or post to a concrete channel.

mutations.name: M2 stop recognizing the byte-exact legacy default
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:persona-templates
mutations.expectRed: legacy-default-upgrade: the byte-exact legacy template gains wildcard post permission
mutations.cell: legacy-default-upgrade: the byte-exact legacy template gains wildcard post permission
mutations.note: This restores the upgrade-path defect: an untouched legacy default remains post-denied after setup reruns.

mutations.name: M3 migrate every existing default regardless of user edits
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:persona-templates
mutations.expectRed: edited-default-preservation: a user-edited legacy persona stays byte-identical
mutations.cell: edited-default-preservation: a user-edited legacy persona stays byte-identical
mutations.note: The preservation cell detects that an edited persona would be overwritten.

mutations.name: M4 drift the frozen legacy fixture to the current wildcard post grant
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:persona-templates
mutations.expectRed: legacy-migration-fixture: the frozen legacy template carries the empty post ACL
mutations.cell: legacy-migration-fixture: the frozen legacy template carries the empty post ACL
mutations.note: This compile-clean mutation makes the frozen fixture cease representing the shipped empty-post default.

mutations.name: M5 remove workflow capability from the setup default
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:persona-templates
mutations.expectRed: default-workflow-capability: the default declares spawn and run
mutations.cell: default-workflow-capability: the default declares spawn and run
mutations.note: Restores the spawn-only default; the smoke checks the parsed on-disk capabilities.

mutations.name: M6 drop the mint lifetime options before they reach the signing seam
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:mint-provision:auth
mutations.find: const options = { name, allowSubscribe, allowPublish, role, capabilities, lifecycleUid, expiresInSeconds: values["expires-in"] !== undefined ? Number(values["expires-in"]) : defaultLifetime ? DEFAULT_LIFETIME_SECONDS : undefined, expiresAt: values["expires-at"] === undefined ? undefined : Number(values["expires-at"]) };
mutations.replace: const options = { name, allowSubscribe, allowPublish, role, capabilities, lifecycleUid };
mutations.expectRed: the JWT's exp is iat + the flag, computed within the command's own second
mutations.cell: the JWT's exp is iat + the flag, computed within the command's own second
mutations.note: The auth-mint smoke dispatches through runCli and checks the JWT lifetime, including its one-second issuance window.

mutations.name: M7 churn the re-minted identity
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:mint-provision:auth
mutations.expectRed: the re-minted credential's principal IS the original's (same nkey, so every durable keyed to it survives)
mutations.cell: the re-minted credential's principal IS the original's (same nkey, so every durable keyed to it survives)
mutations.note: The auth-mint smoke checks that an identity re-sign keeps its principal and lifecycle UID, while --new-incarnation changes only the lifecycle UID.

mutations.name: M8 stop refusing a TTL the seam would refuse
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli typecheck && pnpm smoke:mint-provision:auth
mutations.note: The auth-mint smoke requires zero lifetime to be refused by the CLI before a credential is written.
mutations.afterRestore: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build

mutations.expectRed: default-persona-fix: a space this machine started is fixed by up in its root
mutations.cell: default-persona-fix: a space this machine started is fixed by up in its root
mutations.note: The status, spawn and app-identity remedies all take this decision. The cell grades it directly, without a broker.
